The density-weighted cardinality ensures that public access aligns with legal and ethical norms. Path-based indexing enables efficient querying across domains, while PIT inference provides temporal consistency. Dualities emerge between law enforcement and data integrity—failure modes include unauthorized access, stale values, and non-compliance with attribution rules. The system must maintain coherence under increasing scale and complexity.
